requirement: The system shall retrieve jobs from a ClearML execution queue and prepare Kubernetes jobs using a supplied YAML template. For a job executed in a pod, it shall install the experiment environment, start the experiment process, and monitor its execution.
The agent shall support deployment as a long-running Kubernetes service pod using the clearml-agent Docker image and manage sibling Docker containers through a mapped Docker socket.

The worker shall report status and check connectivity with the ClearML server at configurable intervals, defaulting to 2 seconds and 30 seconds respectively. Standard output and standard error logging shall be enabled by default. Memory reporting shall cover the running process and its subprocesses by default and support a configurable machine-wide scope.

The agent shall support requesting histogram data for task metrics from ClearML, with a configurable number of samples and an iteration-number or time-based horizontal axis, while maintaining compatibility with events service v2.5.
The agent shall support submitting requests to delete a specified model in the ClearML backend, while maintaining compatibility with models service v2.4.
